Definition: from G1537 and G4203; to be utterly unchaste:--give self over to fornication.
BiblicalUsage: ekporneúō means give self over to fornication. In Jude 1:7, the text says "giving themselves over to fornication."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, ekporneúō, does its job quietly — give self over to fornication — and I leave it at that.
